why_whole_columns: Adjacent lines in this index share an entry, so a line-level split leaks: the same lemma, the same citation and often the same rare glyph stand on both sides of it. Whole columns, alternating sides, keep both the clean left columns and the gutter-side right columns in the evaluation.
